flash_695611.description: Nine days before elections, Moti Leitner rejects calls to withdraw his HaTzibbur HaCharedi party, insisting it will cross.

flash_695610.description:
Violent riots erupted in Milan for the second consecutive day amid protests over the rising cost of living. The demonstrations escalated into widespread looting in the city center.

According to media reports, more than 200 people have been arrested, over 80% of them minors. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announced that she will convene an emergency meeting tomorrow in response to the unrest.

flash_695609.description: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi warns Trump after his endorsement of Netanyahu in Israel's election, accusing the Prime Minister of seeking another war.

flash_695615.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards threaten a devastating response against Israel if Iranian energy facilities are attacked, amid escalating warnings between Tehran and Trump.

flash_695614.description:
US President Donald Trump addressed his decision to ease sanctions on Russia, which were intended to limit its ability to continue the war in Ukraine, in a post on Truth Social.

Trump described the decision as "very simple," explaining, I am in the process of negotiating Peace in the war between Russia and Ukraine, and don’t want to do anything that will drive, foolishly, Russia away from the bargaining table. Great progress is being made, and that includes current hostage negotiations! Signing that document at this time will do that, and I can sign it later, or any time that I want! Perhaps more importantly, Russia is doing very little, if anything, to help the Islamic Republic of Iran, compared to what they could be doing, and I want to keep it that way, and will, unless stupid people get in the way."

Referring to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, Trump claimed that he "doesn't care" about the impact on the diesel market and accused him of being unwilling to end the war. "He doesn’t want to end this war, and probably never did. He could have made a better deal two years ago than he can now. His country is in shambles, a large portion of his land is lost, his oceans and seas are gone, and his male population is low, wounded, and/or dead. I WANT THIS WAR END!"

flash_695613.description: PM Carney confirms four Canadian service members were killed and dozens seriously injured in a fire at CFB Wainwright in Alberta.

flash_695612.description:
At least one person was killed and two others were injured in a Russian strike on Ukraine's capital, Kyiv, the city's mayor announced.

According to the mayor, the buildings hit in the attack were being used as medical facilities.

flash_695631.description: IDF eliminated three Hamas terrorists in northern Gaza who were involved in weapons production, military engineering and efforts to restore the terror group's capabilities, in violation of the ceasefire.

flash_695630.description: Judicial Reform: The Tragedy of the “Goats" Netanyahu Could Not Remove Dr. Aaron Lerner 18.10.2026 In an interview with Kalman Liebskind published in Makor Rishon on 24 September 2026, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said,

flash_695628.description: Chabad emissary Rabbi Tzvi Bassman spoke to Arutz Sheva about the 150-year-old synagogue he heads, which has reopened to serve a community made up entirely of teenagers.

flash_695626.description:
The “Tzeva Shachor" alert system sent voice messages to thousands of haredi residents in Arad overnight, warning that authorities were attempting to arrest a haredi draft evader in the city.

Hundreds of Gerrer Hasidim rushed to the scene in response, but it later emerged that no arrest attempt had taken place.

flash_695625.description: Rabbi David Fendel of Sderot Yeshiva defends rabbis’ involvement in politics, warned against voting for parties that may fail to cross the electoral threshold, and lamented divisions in Religious Zionism.

flash_695623.description: Macklemore's upcoming London concert will raise funds for the Palestine Youth Movement, whose UK spokesperson defended Hamas's October 7 hostage-taking.

flash_695621.description:
Marc Zell, chairman of chairman of Republicans Overseas Israel, commented in an interview with Reshet Bet radio on US President Donald Trump's endorsement of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of the upcoming elections.

Zell attributed Trump's support to the US administration's strategic considerations, saying: "Trump is looking at the interests of the United States regarding Iran and the entire region. Political deadlock and repeated elections send a message of weakness."

flash_695620.description: Michigan Democrat Abdul El-Sayed disavows the Muslim Brotherhood but challenges why he was asked, amid scrutiny of his positions on Israel and Hamas.

flash_695618.description: Vice President JD Vance says he may skip the 2028 presidential race, citing his wife and four children, despite leading early Republican primary polls.

flash_695616.description:
An Israeli man in his 60s arrived at the entrance to Ma'ale Adumim from the village of Al-Eizariya suffering from gunshot wounds.

A Magen David Adom team dispatched to the scene examined the man and was forced to pronounce him dead at the scene.

flash_695649.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz warns time to destroy Hamas 'approaching,' says IDF is 'prepared' to demilitarize Gaza.

flash_695648.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu visits IAF base, warns Israel's enemies against attacking the Jewish state.

flash_695645.description: IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir orders leave restrictions, increased commander presence, and additional troop deployments across multiple fronts to ensure Israel's elections proceed safely.

flash_695644.description: Israeli authorities issue urgent recall of Chinese-made universal travel adapter after safety tests reveal defects that could cause electric shock or fire.

flash_695643.description: Newly-revealed Hamas document details plans to plant explosives near displaced civilians, triggering panic and allowing terrorists to escape advancing IDF forces.

flash_695641.description: Jerusalem yeshiva student reveals how he used his passport to smuggle people barred from leaving Israel through Ben Gurion Airport; is released to house arrest.

flash_695639.description: The government has delayed a review of discounts for haredi draft dodgers for months, despite an April High Court ruling ordering the review and officials’ position that public transport discounts can be revoked.

flash_695636.description: Temperatures across Israel to remain below seasonal averages for much of the week, with cloudy skies and possible light coastal showers.

flash_695635.description: Noah and the quiet discipline of change.

flash_695633.description: Dozens of pro-Palestinian rioters attack Turkish-Israeli woman in Istanbul mall, verbally abusing her before turning physical; police investigate.

flash_695629.description:
Today: Partly cloudy to cloudy. Temperatures will drop slightly and remain below seasonal averages across most of the country.

Light drizzle is possible along the coastal plain in the morning.

Tonight: Partly cloudy.

flash_695627.description: The IDF Personnel Directorate, FIDF, and Association for the Soldier honor 2,000 lone soldiers serving in combat roles, many of whom have no family in Israel. The average age of enlistment is 21.

flash_695624.description:
Palestinian sources reported that IDF forces arrested senior Hamas official Abd al-Jarrar Jabbar at his home in Jenin early Monday morning.

According to the reports, Jabbar had previously been imprisoned in Israel and was released about two months ago.

flash_695622.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom calls for conditions on US military aid to Israel, criticizing Netanyahu for “isolating" Israel.

flash_695673.description: In two polls published Monday evening, the Arab parties reached record levels of support, significantly increasing their political strength.

flash_695672.description: Outrage has erupted in the haredi community following a violent incident in Beit Shemesh in which a group of extremists attacked the vehicle of the Karlin-Stolin Rebbe with stones.

flash_695670.description: Blue and White chairman Benny Gantz delivered a statement following his withdrawal from the Knesset race and warned party leaders: "Do not take us back to October 6.'

flash_695668.description: A president so confident about criticizing another democracy should bring the same urgency to protecting his own citizens. Opinion.

flash_695666.description:
A short while ago, sirens were sounded regarding a suspected terrorist infiltration in the area of Evyatar.

The IDF stated that it remains in close contact with the local communities and security forces in the region.

flash_695664.description: Ukraine's military announced that it successfully evacuated a wounded soldier from a combat zone using a heavy-lift drone after minefields and the threat of Russian drones made evacuation by land impossible.

flash_695662.description: Report of Israeli attack in southern Lebanon

flash_695660.description: Moshe Feiglin tells Arutz Sheva that Netanyahu should have resigned, calls for fundamental change in Israel's military strategy, and explains decision to run alongside Bezalel Smotrich.

flash_695658.description:
Fire and rescue teams continue to operate at the Intel plant following a leak of hazardous materials, in cooperation with police forces, the Ministry of Environmental Protection, and the plant's emergency team.

The forces operating at the scene are formulating an operational plan for further handling of the incident.

flash_695656.description: Qatar is expected to build two power plants in Lebanon and sign an agreement to supply liquefied natural gas to the country for 20 years, according to a draft plan for the Lebanese electricity sector obtained by Reuters.

flash_695654.description: Blue and White chairman Benny Gantz announced that he will not run in the upcoming elections.

flash_695652.description:
Yesterday (Sunday), IDF soldiers operated in the area of Kafr Aqab and, based on ISA intelligence, apprehended two terrorists who were advancing an imminent terror attack and operating to establish terrorist infrastructure.

The terrorists were apprehended and transferred for further questioning by the security forces.

flash_695651.description: The billionaire entrepreneur announced plans to give one SpaceX share to each of America's approximately 72 million children in 2027, calling it the 'first of many.'

flash_695647.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz insists police, not the IDF, must handle Jewish rioters in Judea and Samaria, rejecting calls to restore administrative detention despite recent violence.

flash_695646.description: Fleur Hassan-Nahoum, a candidate for the Amcha Yisrael party, led by Ofer Winter, and her team were attacked with stones during an outreach tour with the Regavim movement in the village of Turmus Ayya in the Binyamin region.

flash_695682.description: Benny Gantz's withdrawal from the Knesset race sparks calls on the right to prevent wasted votes on parties polling below the electoral threshold.

flash_695681.description:
US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during a visit to Israel on Monday, two sources with knowledge told Axios.

Read more

flash_695679.description:
US President Donald Trump's envoys, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, are planning to travel to Norway for talks with Ukraine, Reuters reported, citing three sources familiar with the matter.

Two of the sources said Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is also expected to participate in the talks.

flash_695677.description: President Trump criticizes Macron over violent riots in France, saying he had warned him about radical Islam and urging him to close the country's borders.

flash_695675.description: Netanyahu's adviser estimated during his interrogation in the Qatargate investigation that his work promoting Qatar's image continued throughout much of the war and claimed that he had not informed the Prime Minister about it.

flash_695671.description: At least two Jewish women were assaulted in Stamford Hill, with one suffering significant bruising. Police arrested a suspect on suspicion of racially and religiously aggravated grievous bodily harm.

flash_695669.description: While Aliyah involves a journey, it isn’t just about moving to Israel. Instead, it is a rebirth. And just as every birthing experience is unique, so too, every Aliyah story is unique.

flash_695667.description: Netanyahu calls Trump to thank him for his endorsement; Trump predicts a major victory and calls him a warrior. 'You're the man I want by my side, Bibi.'

flash_695665.description: Former Israeli diplomat Yaki Dayan explains Trump's endorsement of Netanyahu, dismisses the polling theory, and warns of another round with Iran.

flash_695663.description: The mitzvah of Torah study rests upon parents, who must ensure that their sons learn these fundamentals while they are still young.

flash_695659.description: At least 80 people were killed in a drone attack near a market and a transportation station in the town of A-Dibab in the state of West Kordofan in Sudan. This was reported by the AFP news agency, citing a medical source and an eyewitness. Most of the dead were civilians waiting for transportation home.

flash_695657.description: Habib criticizes the Macron administration following riots and looting in France, accuses the authorities of failing to act, and links hostility toward Israel to the crisis gripping the country.

flash_695655.description:
Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar spoke on the phone on Monday with Poland’s Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister, Radosław Sikorski.

The two discussed the significant increase in Israeli tourism to Poland and opportunities to expand cooperation, dialogue, and investment between the countries. In addition, they discussed the war in Ukraine and the situation in the Middle East.

Sa'ar updated Minister Sikorski on the police investigation into the incident in Judea and Samaria involving several diplomats, including the Polish Consul.

flash_695653.description: The mother of former hostage Avinatan Or blames the Prime Minister for allowing funds to flow to Hamas and for the prolonged war, but stops short of saying he should have resigned.

flash_695692.description: An Arkia flight from New York to Tel Aviv was forced to make an unscheduled landing in Canada following a medical emergency on board.

flash_695691.description: British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband warns companies bidding on E1 construction projects near Jerusalem that they could face sanctions.

flash_695689.description: US Supreme Court rejects Khalid Sheikh Mohammed's attempt to reinstate a plea deal that would spare him the death penalty, clearing the way for a 2028 trial.

flash_695687.description: NYPD investigates possible antisemitic hate crime after Palestine Action claims vandalism at a Manhattan bank, amid rising concern over attacks on New York Jews.

flash_695685.description: Germany summons Iran's ambassador after two men are jailed over a plot targeting prominent Jewish figures. Tehran rejects the allegations and summons Berlin's envoy.

flash_695683.description: Vice President JD Vance declines to endorse Netanyahu in Israel's election despite Trump's support, explains he is focusing on the midterms.

flash_695680.description: Despite Netanyahu's promises of a senior position in the next government, Ben Gvir fears the Prime Minister will prefer a coalition with Eisenkot.

flash_695678.description: Syrian officials fear Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu could take extraordinary action on Syrian territory to gain a political advantage ahead of Israel's elections.

flash_695674.description: The genocide that is being waged in the Middle East is from the Arabs to the Arabs. Opinion.

flash_695711.description: Saudis report intercepting Houthi missile launched at Riyadh

flash_695710.description: Former Attorney General Mandelblit tells court he does not recall approving a bribery investigation into Netanyahu in Case 4000.

flash_695708.description:
Police officers from the Judea and Samaria District launched an investigation following reports of an arson incident in the village of Burqa and a confrontation in the village of Ein Yabrud in the Binyamin region.

Police officers and forensic investigators entered Burqa accompanied by IDF forces, collected findings and evidence, and took witness statements.

Police stated that the investigation is ongoing and that forces are also expected to enter the scene in Ein Yabrud.

flash_695707.description:
Detectives from the Western Galilee Police Station and Border Police officers from the Coastal District raided a compound in the village of Yarka, uncovering commercial quantities of substances suspected to be drugs, including approximately 8 kilograms of hashish and 1,000 Captagon pills, known as the "courage drug," which have also been used by Hamas and ISIS terrorists. The drugs were allegedly intended for distribution.

During the raid, officers also seized communications devices and a digital surveillance system, which are suspected of having been intended for monitoring and surveillance for criminal purposes. Two local residents were arrested and taken to the Western Galilee Police Station for further questioning.

flash_695705.description: Months after Lebanon’s army claimed it had addressed a Hezbollah weapons site in southern Lebanon, the terror group was caught removing weapons and military equipment in the region.

flash_695703.description: A 38-year-old resident of Rama was arrested after a helicopter spotted him driving dangerously along a narrow mountain road in northern Israel, crossing a solid white line and entering the oncoming lane.

flash_695701.description: Ten young men arrested over alleged attacks on a French diplomat and an American journalist face continued detention as their lawyers blast the investigation as baseless, accuse police of mass arrests, and demand answers.

flash_695699.description: Former long-time Likud member Tzachi Hanegbi announces he will vote for Liberman, criticizing the right over haredi draft exemptions and other issues.

flash_695697.description: The status quo is not neutral. It carries risks of its own, and those risks must be confronted honestly and thoroughly - and dealt with. Opinion.

flash_695695.description: It’s not enough to read the parasha on Shabbat, but its ideas and lessons should accompany us throughout the week.

flash_695693.description: Columbia University protest leader Mahmoud Khalil asks the Supreme Court to review a ruling that could allow the Trump administration to detain and deport him.

flash_695690.description: CNN's Christiane Amanpour announces her departure after 43 years, following controversies over her remarks on Israel, Hamas hostages and Nazi Germany.

flash_695688.description: Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed says Israel is not a US ally, accusing it of drawing America into wars and criticizing military assistance.

flash_695684.description:
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) issued a new threat, suggesting it could target undersea communications infrastructure in the Strait of Hormuz.

In a statement, the IRGC warned: "Seven major internet cables run beneath the Strait of Hormuz. The enemy should know that we have new targets."

flash_695728.description: Defense Minister warns: If Hezbollah joins an Iranian attack, the IDF will capture additional territory in Lebanon and incorporate it into the security zone.

flash_695727.description:
A new mediation proposal reportedly calls for the release of $6 billion in frozen Iranian funds in exchange for Iran allowing International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) inspectors to visit its nuclear sites.

According to the Qatari-based Al-Araby Al-Jadeed news outlet, Qatar and Pakistan are behind the proposal, which would release $6 billion in interest accrued on Iranian funds frozen in Qatari banks in return for a covert visit by IAEA inspectors to Iran’s nuclear facilities.

The report says the proposal has received US approval and preliminary Iranian agreement. However, no official confirmation of an agreement has been issued.

flash_695725.description: A groundbreaking medical device that stimulates the brain without opening the skull offers new hope to epilepsy patients who cannot be helped by medication or conventional surgery.

flash_695723.description: IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir visited a large-scale Gaza Division exercise and warned that Israel's enemies continue planning attacks despite suffering heavy blows.

flash_695721.description: A 23-year-old man has been missing from Jerusalem since August 2, prompting an extensive search by specialist dog teams.

flash_695719.description: The IDF is developing a new assessment to uncover hidden talents and open military career paths to candidates who may have been overlooked by traditional recruitment screening.

flash_695717.description: The fourth season of Netflix's political drama 'The Diplomat' includes a reference to Hersh Goldberg-Polin and Aner Shapira, who were attacked by Hamas terrorists on October 7.

flash_695715.description: Likud rejects opposition accusations over Netanyahu's haredi draft remarks, insisting that those who refuse to enlist will face imprisonment.

flash_695713.description: IDF soldiers operating in the southern Lebanon security zone in recent weeks destroyed more than 540 terrorist infrastructure sites and located more than 150 weapons.

flash_695709.description: The IDF is weighing a major crackdown on haredi men who ignored draft orders, including shortening the threshold for criminal prosecution and exposing more draft evaders to potential prison sentences of up to six months.

flash_695706.description: Military Police detain 25 Chabad yeshiva students returning from New York over unresolved draft status; Chabad rabbis work to secure their release.

flash_695704.description: Netanyahu promises a new haredi conscription law, condemns arrests of yeshiva students, and rules out a plea deal; Eisenkot vows to oppose him.

flash_695700.description:
Last Thursday, the IDF and Shin Bet struck across the Gaza Strip and dismantled three weapons storage facilities used by Hamas' military wing.

The Hamas terrorist organization stored dozens of weapons of various types in the facilities, including RPGs, launchers, rockets, Kalashnikov rifles, and additional combat equipment.

flash_695742.description: A 9-year-old boy from Kedumim spotted a suspicious object near the community and alerted his father. Security forces discovered it was a missile fuel tank left from the war with Iran and safely removed it.

flash_695741.description: One week before the elections, Channel 14 poll: Likud leads with 30 seats, Amcha Yisrael falls far below threshold.

flash_695740.description: France will deploy military forces in Paris and Marseille, Italy will station 500 soldiers in Milan, and Albania reports 295 people injured.

flash_695739.description: After fighting on October 7, taking part in battles across the Gaza Strip and losing his comrades in Rafah, Captain Y. looks to the new generation of recruits with great faith, 'the spirit of victory of the Jewish people is stronger than ever.'

flash_695738.description: The IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Akram Bassam Shaaban Yassin, a senior Hamas official responsible for protecting the terrorist organization's leadership.

flash_695736.description: Fifteen cadets graduate as Hashmonaim Brigade’s first officers. Chief of staff says they are breaking new ground in integrating haredim into the IDF and building the brigade’s command echelon.

flash_695734.description: The IDF and Shin Bet eliminated a Hamas terrorist who participated in the abduction of Shani Louk during the October 7 massacre.

flash_695732.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu says he discussed toppling the Iranian regime with US President Donald Trump, declaring that the move would lead to Hezbollah's elimination and peace with Lebanon.

flash_695730.description: The real story behind the media lies. Opinion.

flash_695726.description: The Prime Minister and Finance Minister are currently meeting with Rabbi Eli Sadan, Ofer Winter's rabbi, amid efforts to persuade him to withdraw from the election race.

flash_695724.description: President Isaac Herzog met Hungarian President András Baka in Budapest, praising Hungary's commitment to combating antisemitism and strengthening ties with Israel.

flash_695722.description: A Barcelona match jersey and captain's armband bearing the Argentine star's signature were stolen from a store in central Paris during the riots in the French capital.

flash_695718.description: Yoaz Hendel and Yaron Zelekha rule out joining a Netanyahu-Haredi coalition, demand universal conscription, and warn of a threat to Israel's future.

flash_695716.description:
Police officers from the Binyamin Police Station in the Judea and Samaria District were dispatched following a report of an assault on a shepherd in an area authorized for grazing, near the Chesed Leavraham Farm in the Binyamin region.

Upon arriving at the scene, officers began collecting evidence and findings and taking witness statements as part of an investigation launched to determine the circumstances of the incident.

flash_695714.description: An Australian lawmaker was left critically injured after a driver allegedly ran her over twice. Reports point to the suspect’s anti-Israel activism as investigators examine whether the attack was politically motivated.

flash_695747.description: Senior officials from the IDF, Israel Security Agency (Shin Bet), and Israel Police met and decided that IDF soldiers would take over some of the duties currently performed by Border Police officers in Judea and Samaria, allowing the officers to focus on combating nationalist crime and riots in the area, Kan 11 News reported.

flash_695746.description: US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth confirms an unannounced visit to Israel and meeting with Netanyahu, but declines to reveal what was discussed.

flash_695744.description: The man whose report led to the arrests on Highway 1 has been located and admitted that he lied. The suspects are apparently not terrorists, but the Shin Bet investigation is ongoing.

flash_695743.description: North Korea has released new photographs of Kim Jong Un and his 13-year-old daughter following rumors that the dictator died of a brain hemorrhage.

flash_695737.description: Creation, Creativity, and the Existential Responsibility of Man.

flash_695735.description: In a first-ever interview with Abu Ali Express, the Religious Zionism leader calls to dismantle the Palestinian Authority, pledges an ambitious expansion of Jewish communities, and promises further tax cuts.

flash_695733.description: Sometimes, the responsible course is to stand firmly on principle. At other times, it is to recognise that cooperation is necessary to protect what matters most.

flash_695729.description: A fundraising campaign is seeking support for 18-month-old Avishag Esther, who is suffering from a tumor. Her parents, Natan and Tamar, are appealing for help as they seek the medical care their daughter needs.

flash_695720.description: New Walla! poll gives Eisenkot's Yashar 23 seats to Likud's 19, as Netanyahu's bloc falls to 48 seats and neither side secures a majority.

flash_695754.description: British counterterrorism police re-arrest two men suspected of assisting Iranian intelligence near RAF Fairford, a base used by US bombers in strikes on Iran.

flash_695753.description:
Iraq's Prime Minister has ordered the gradual closure of several border crossings with Iran over the coming days, an Iraqi government official told Al Jazeera.

According to the official, the Al-Sheeb border crossing will be closed to passenger traffic and the movement of goods starting Wednesday.

flash_695751.description: US envoy Steve Witkoff is expected to present Russian President Vladimir Putin with a proposed peace agreement following talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, Axios reported.

flash_695749.description:
Hezbollah has raised its alert level in recent days amid concerns over a possible escalation with Israel or growing internal tensions in Lebanon, the Lebanese Al-Jadeed television channel reported.

According to the report, the latest round of talks between Israeli and Lebanese military delegations, held Tuesday in Tampa, Florida, has concluded and is expected to resume tomorrow. During the discussions, disagreements emerged over who would have the authority to oversee the implementation of security arrangements in southern Lebanon.

The report also claimed that the Lebanese government reserves the right to oppose any mechanism that would give Israel direct influence over the Lebanese military's movements and decisions in the south of the country.

flash_695748.description: Journalist Neria Kraus interviewed a man in Paris who claimed to be an Arab supporter of Israel. Only later did she discover he was Hezi from Kfar Shalem.

flash_695731.description: During the 1950s, you would not become mayor of New York City IF YOU WERE A COMMUNIST. You would be in JAIL. Op-ed.

flash_695765.description: From Mount Hermon to Eilat and across Israel's borders, IDF soldiers begin casting their ballots at 850 military polling stations, including mobile stations for troops on operational missions.

flash_695764.description: He appeared to be an ordinary taxi driver in Bethlehem, but Israeli undercover officers discovered him helping rebuild Islamic Jihad's infrastructure and finance terrorist activity.

flash_695762.description: United Torah Judaism, Shas MKs blast enforcement system, claim elections interference, after 42 Chabad yeshiva students are arrested.

flash_695760.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu allegedly ordered the Israel Defense Forces to prepare for a large-scale military strike against Iran, but the operation was halted following opposition from US President Donald Trump.

flash_695758.description: President Trump declines to endorse JD Vance for 2028, saying it is too early to discuss the race.

flash_695756.description: A week after leaving Ofer Winter's party, Davidi Ben Zion explains his decision and admits he misjudged the party's chances of crossing the electoral threshold.

flash_695752.description: Iran's security chief rules out transferring enriched uranium abroad and demands US concessions before talks, as Pakistan seeks to mediate amid rising tensions.

flash_695750.description: Speaking to i24NEWS, Netanyahu warns Iran may use proxies to disrupt Israel's election, calls for regime change in Tehran, and criticizes Macron over unrest in France.

flash_695745.description: President Trump says the US must decide how to secure victory over Iran, declines to provide details on Hegseth's meetings in Israel.

flash_695785.description: Netanyahu urges Ofer Winter to withdraw from the Knesset race after bereaved families warn his candidacy could cost the right crucial votes.

flash_695784.description: Far-left New York congressional candidate Brad Lander says Israeli forces detained him and dozens of activists during an olive harvest near Bethlehem.

flash_695782.description: A mother who traveled to Tel Aviv discovered that she had left her toddler in a car in Yavne. Police officers smashed a window and rescued him.

flash_695780.description: Likud accused Ben Gvir of spreading lies and helping the left. Otzma Yehudit responded with a sharp attack, claiming that Likud is working to establish a government without Ben Gvir.

flash_695778.description: Former Attorney General Avichai Mandelblit acknowledged unauthorized investigative activity, suspected media leaks were intended to pressure him, and said he was not informed of a potential conflict of interest involving a senior investigator.

flash_695776.description: Forty-year-old daycare employee in Ariel arrested on suspicion of abuse after police uncover evidence in security camera footage.

flash_695774.description: IDF, ISA, eliminate Nukhba terrorist involved in planning explosive attack that killed four soldiers from IDF's Battalion 52 last year.

flash_695772.description: A casual phone call exposed a Jewish identity hidden since the Holocaust, transforming the German-born artist's faith, identity, and destiny. Now, her extraordinary journey has brought her home to Israel.

flash_695770.description: Earthquake measuring 3.4 felt in the Arava region in southern Israel

flash_695768.description: What is needed is a military result so unequivocal that it changes how the enemy thinks. Opinion.

flash_695766.description: In dramatic reversal, 40 Chabad-Lubavitch yeshiva students detained at Ben Gurion Airport for draft evasion agree to enlist in the IDF; two others remain in military prison.

flash_695763.description: Western Europe has administered a lethal dose of poison to itself and is now writhing in convulsions. Opinion.

flash_695761.description: The philosophical dilemma for liberals is the belief that progressivism is an intrinsic Jewish value, and that surging leftist antisemitism must therefore be a reaction to bad Jewish behavior. Have they lost their minds as well as their memory? Opinion.

flash_695759.description: Lebanese authorities seek to question two Hezbollah officials after seizing half a ton of explosives, as the group demands the shipment be returned.

flash_695757.description: The International Criminal Court is shortlisted for the EU's Sakharov Prize despite Trump administration sanctions targeting its actions against Israel and the US.
